Topic 10.3: Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

1. explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi from Kenya
3. practise Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi in clear steps
4. apply Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUANDIKA 10.3.1 BARUA RASMI YA KUOMBA KAZI
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

PART 1: Explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
